==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L6344}}
[[Image:Cocacola-5cents-1900 edit1.jpg|thumb|A [[Coca-Cola]] advertisement from the 1890s]]

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|advertizement}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:bor|frm:advertissement|tree=1}}
From {{bor|en|frm|advertissement||statement calling attention}}, compare {{cog|fr|avertissement||warning}}. See [[advertise]]. Equivalent to {{suffix|en|advertise|ment}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{rfap|en|UK/RP pronunciation audio}}
* {{IPA|en|/ədˈvɜːtɪsmənt/|q2=occasionally|/ˈædvəˌtaɪzmənt/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈædvɚˌtaɪzmənt/|/ˌædvɚˈtaɪzmənt/|q3=less often|/ədˈvɝtɪzmənt/|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-advertisement.wav|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-advertisement.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ədˈvøːtəsmənt/|/ˈɛdvəˌtaɪzmənt/|a=NZ}}
** {{audio|en|En-advertisement.oga}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈædvəˌtɪzmənt/|a=Singapore}}
* {{IPA|en|/ʔɐd.vəɹˈtaɪs.mɛnt/|/ʔɐdˈvəɹ.tis.mɛnt/|a=Philippines}}
* {{hyphenation|en|ad|ver|tise|ment}}

===Noun===
{{wp}}
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|marketing}} A [[commercial]] [[solicitation]] designed to sell some [[commodity]], [[service]] or similar.
#: {{ux|en|Companies try to sell their products using '''advertisements''' in form of placards, television spots and print publications.}}
# A [[public]] [[notice]].
#: {{ux|en|The city council placed an '''advertisement''' in the local newspaper to inform its residents of the forthcoming roadworks.}}
# A [[recommendation]] of a [[particular]] [[product]], [[service]] or [[person]].
#: {{ux|en|The good manners and intelligence of the students are an '''advertisement''' for the school.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[notoriety|Notoriety]].
# {{lb|en|card games}} In [[gin rummy]], the discarding of a card of one's preferred [[suit]] so as to mislead the opponent into thinking you do not want it.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1947|title=On Gin Rummy: An All-American Roundup|page=121
|passage=The safest time to answer a possible '''advertisement''' is when you have no indication as to what suit your opponent wants. Then even if he has advertised, the odds are that your answer is not the card he is looking for.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete|literary}} A [[preface]].
